name: Pozán de Vero (Spain)
description: Vairy of white and blue with a green triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly bearing a white fleur-de-lis.
history: Municipal flag of Pozán de Vero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
